# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

if (!requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")
}
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(survival)
  library(survminer)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  library(forcats)
})


load("../controlled_data/TIL/clin_final_TIL.R")
load("../public/clin_final.R")
```



# Create combined dataset
```{r}
# Hugo
# gse_hugo <- getGEO("GSE78220", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
fn <- "../controlled_data/aPD1/GSE78220_series_matrix.txt.gz"
gse_hugo <- getGEO(
  filename = fn,
  GSEMatrix = TRUE,
  destdir="../controlled_data/aPD1/"
)

# getGEOSuppFiles("GSE78220", makeDirectory = TRUE)
fp <- file.path("GSE78220", "GSE78220_PatientFPKM.xlsx")
hugo_fpkm <- read.xlsx(fp)
gene_col <- hugo_fpkm[[1]]
expr_hugo <- as.matrix(hugo_fpkm[ , -1])
rownames(expr_hugo) <- gene_col


pheno_hugo    <- pData(gse_hugo)
#remove the non baselines
pheno_hugo <- subset(pheno_hugo, `biopsy time:ch1` == "pre-treatment")

pheno_hugo$PtID <- paste0(pheno_hugo$title,".baseline")

expr_hugo <- expr_hugo[ , pheno_hugo$PtID]  # reorder columns to match pheno rows
 

# Riaz
fn <- "../controlled_data/aPD1/GSE91061_series_matrix.txt.gz"
gse_riaz <- getGEO(
  filename = fn,
  GSEMatrix = TRUE,
  destdir="../controlled_data/aPD1/"
)

pheno_riaz    <- pData(gse_riaz)

# getGEOSuppFiles("GSE91061", makeDirectory = TRUE)
fs <- list.files("GSE91061", full.names = TRUE)
fs


# pick the one that looks like "fpkm" or "counts"
fpkm_file  <- fs[grepl("fpkm",  fs, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]  # adjust if needed
counts_file <- fs[grepl("count", fs, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

# Read FPKM matrix (genes x samples)
riaz_fpkm <- read.csv(fpkm_file)
entrez_ids <- as.character(riaz_fpkm$X)

# Expression values
expr_riaz_raw <- as.matrix(riaz_fpkm[ , -1])
rownames(expr_riaz_raw) <- entrez_ids


# Unique Entrez IDs to map
entrez_unique <- unique(entrez_ids)

map_tab <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys     = entrez_unique,
  keytype  = "ENTREZID",
  columns  = c("SYMBOL")
)
# map_tab has columns: ENTREZID, SYMBOL
# Match in the correct order
sym_vec <- map_tab$SYMBOL[ match(entrez_ids, map_tab$ENTREZID) ]

# Drop rows without a valid symbol
keep <- !is.na(sym_vec) & sym_vec != ""
expr_riaz_sym0 <- expr_riaz_raw[keep, , drop = FALSE]
sym_vec_keep   <- sym_vec[keep]

# Set rownames to symbols (still can have duplicates)
rownames(expr_riaz_sym0) <- sym_vec_keep

collapse_by_symbol <- function(mat) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  df$gene <- rownames(df)
  df %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene")
}

expr_riaz_sym <- collapse_by_symbol(expr_riaz_sym0)

#take only baselines
pheno_riaz <- subset(pheno_riaz, `visit (pre or on treatment):ch1` =="Pre")
#adjust colnames 
colnames(expr_riaz_sym) <- gsub("\\.", "-",colnames(expr_riaz_sym))
expr_riaz <- expr_riaz_sym[ , pheno_riaz$title]  # reorder columns to match pheno rows

common_genes <- intersect(rownames(expr_hugo), rownames(expr_riaz))

expr_hugo_rpkm <- expr_hugo[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
expr_riaz_rpkm <- expr_riaz[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

## 2) Optional but recommended: log2-transform to match other cohorts
expr_hugo_logrpkm <- log2(expr_hugo_rpkm + 1)
expr_riaz_logrpkm <- log2(expr_riaz_rpkm + 1)

## 3) Combine Hugo + Riaz
expr_combined <- cbind(expr_hugo_logrpkm, expr_riaz_logrpkm)

#create metadata
pheno_hugo_sub <- pheno_hugo %>% 
  transmute(
    sample_id           = rownames(.),
    title               = title,
    cohort              = "Hugo",
    age                 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`age (yrs):ch1`)),
    anatomical_location = as.character(`anatomical location:ch1`),
    response            = as.character(`anti-pd-1 response:ch1`),
    braf_status         = as.character(`braf:ch1`),
    disease_status      = as.character(`disease status:ch1`),
    gender              = as.character(`gender:ch1`),
    nf1_status          = as.character(`nf1:ch1`),
    nras_status         = as.character(`nras:ch1`),
    os_days             = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`overall survival (days):ch1`)),
    previous_mapki      = as.character(`previous mapki:ch1`),
    vital_status        = as.character(`vital status:ch1`)
)

pheno_hugo_sub <- pheno_hugo %>% 
  transmute(
    sample_id           = rownames(.),
    title               = PtID,
    cohort              = "Hugo",
    age                 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`age (yrs):ch1`)),
    anatomical_location = as.character(`anatomical location:ch1`),
    response            = case_when(
      `anti-pd-1 response:ch1` == "Progressive Disease" ~ "PD",
      `anti-pd-1 response:ch1` == "Complete Response" ~ "CR",
      `anti-pd-1 response:ch1` == "Partial Response" ~ "PR"
      ),
    braf_status         = as.character(`braf:ch1`),
    disease_status      = as.character(`disease status:ch1`),
    gender              = as.character(`gender:ch1`),
    nf1_status          = as.character(`nf1:ch1`),
    nras_status         = as.character(`nras:ch1`),
    os_days             = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`overall survival (days):ch1`)),
    previous_mapki      = as.character(`previous mapki:ch1`),
    vital_status        = case_when(
      `vital status:ch1` == "Dead" ~ "1",
      `vital status:ch1` == "Alive" ~ "0", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    cytolytic_score=NA_real_
  ) %>% mutate(dataset="Hugo")


pheno_riaz_additional <- read.xlsx("GSE91061/meta_riaz.xlsx")
pheno_riaz_additional$Patient
pheno_riaz$Patient <- str_split_i(pattern = "_",string = pheno_riaz$title,1)
pheno_riaz<- pheno_riaz %>% left_join(pheno_riaz_additional, by="Patient")
pheno_riaz_sub <- pheno_riaz %>% 
  transmute(
    sample_id           = rownames(.),
    title               = title,
    cohort              = "Riaz",
    age                 = NA_real_,        # numeric, matches Hugo$age
    anatomical_location = NA_character_,
    response            = as.character(Response),
    braf_status         = NA_character_,
    disease_status      = NA_character_,
    gender              = NA_character_,
    nf1_status          = NA_character_,
    nras_status         = NA_character_,
    os_days             = `Time.to.Death.(weeks)`*7,        # numeric, matches Hugo$os_days
    previous_mapki      = NA_character_,
    vital_status        = case_when(
      `Dead/Alive.(Dead.=.True)` == "TRUE" ~ "1",
      `Dead/Alive.(Dead.=.True)` == "FALSE" ~ "0", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    cytolytic_score = as.numeric(Cytolytic.Score)
  ) %>% mutate(dataset="Riaz")

pheno_combined <- bind_rows(pheno_hugo_sub, pheno_riaz_sub) 

pheno_combined <- as.data.frame(pheno_combined)
rownames(pheno_combined) <- NULL

# Now set sample_id as rownames manually
rownames(pheno_combined) <- pheno_combined$sample_id
pheno_combined$sample_id <- NULL

```

# Univariate analysis in the combined apd1 cohort

```{r}
#calculate signature
rank_data_apd1 <- rankGenes(expr_combined)
scores_apd1 <- simpleScore(rank_data_apd1,
                      upSet   = up_list,
                      downSet = down_list)
#rownames(scores) <- gsub(x= rownames(scores), pattern = "\\.", replacement = "-")
scores_apd1$sample <- rownames(scores_apd1)
scores_apd1 <- subset(scores_apd1, sample %in% pheno_hugo_sub$title)
pheno_combined <- subset(pheno_combined, title %in% scores_apd1$sample)
scores_apd1 <- scores_apd1[order(scores_apd1$sample, pheno_combined$title),]

pheno_combined$signature_score <- scores_apd1$TotalScore[
  match(pheno_combined$title, scores_apd1$sample)
]

# Check they all matched:
stopifnot(!any(is.na(pheno_combined$signature_score)))


# 3) Define your group (you already have this)
pheno_combined <- as.data.frame(pheno_combined) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = if_else(signature_score >= 
                                  quantile(signature_score, 0.75),
                                "High","Low"))

pheno_combined %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(response), !is.na(signature_score)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = response, y = signature_score)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = dataset, label = title)) +
  labs(
    x = "Response",
    y = "Signature score",
    title = "Signature score by response (Hugo + Riaz)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

pheno_for_resp <- pheno_combined %>%
  mutate(
    resp_bin = case_when(
      response %in% c("CR", "PR") ~ "Response",   # responders
      response %in% c("SD", "PD") ~ "No response",   # non-responders
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(resp_bin))

# summary(glm(resp_bin ~ signature_score + cohort,
#             data = pheno_for_resp,
#             family = binomial))

ggplot(pheno_for_resp, aes(x=resp_bin, y = signature_score))+
  geom_violin()+geom_point()+stat_compare_means()

pheno_for_resp$vital_status <- as.numeric(pheno_for_resp$vital_status)
pheno_for_resp$OS.months <- pheno_for_resp$os_days/30.99
fit_apd1 <- survfit(
  Surv(OS.months, vital_status) ~ group,
  data = pheno_for_resp)


# 5) Plot
ggsurvplot(
  fit_apd1,
  data       = pheno_for_resp,
  pval       = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE
)
```

# Joined cohort analysis

```{r}
tcga_df <- clin_final %>%
  transmute(cohort = "TCGA", time = OS.time,            event = OS,           signature_score)
apd1_df <- pheno_combined %>%
  transmute(cohort = "ICI",  time = os_days,            event = vital_status, signature_score)
til_df  <- clin_final_TIL %>%
  transmute(cohort = "TIL",  time = OS.months * 30.44,  event = OS_censored,  signature_score)

all_surv <- bind_rows(tcga_df, apd1_df, til_df) %>%
  mutate(event = as.numeric(event)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(event), !is.na(signature_score)) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA", "ICI", "TIL")))

all_surv <- all_surv %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  mutate(signature_z = as.numeric(scale(signature_score))) %>%
  ungroup()

cox_tab <- all_surv %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    s <- summary(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ signature_z, data = .x))
    tibble(
      n      = s$n,
      events = s$nevent,
      HR     = s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"],
      lower  = s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
      upper  = s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"],
      p      = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s  (n=%d, events=%d)", cohort, n, events),
         label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))))  # TCGA on top

pA <- ggplot(cox_tab, aes(x = HR, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("HR %.2f (%.2f-%.2f), p=%.2g", HR, lower, upper, p)),
            vjust = -1.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "HR per 1 SD increase in HLA-II^CONST score (log scale)",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Continuous-score association with overall survival") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
pB <- ggplot(all_surv, aes(x = cohort, y = signature_z, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Signature score (z within cohort)",
       title = "Score distribution by cohort") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
fit_overall <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ cohort, data = all_surv)
gg_risk <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_overall, data = all_surv,
  risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.height = 0.5,
  conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
  legend.title = "Cohort",
  xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "Overall survival",
  ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11)
)
pC <- plot_grid(gg_risk$plot, gg_risk$table, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(2, 1.1))

```

```{r}
top <- plot_grid(pA, pB, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.4, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
supp_fig12 <- plot_grid(top, pC, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1.2),
                        labels = c("", "C"))

```
